Nina bought a coat at the shop yesterday. They took many photos at the night snack bar. Nina hopes to visit Sydney one day. In fact, the kids asked for macaroni and cheese again.
There are always many people at the night snack bar. Nina wrote about the day in the diary. Both of them like salad and juice. What's more, email makes communication between friends fast and easy.
Nina and David had great fun there. Nina spent the weekend at the zoo. Nina is going to travel to Sydney in October.
